transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I guess… I’m having a hard time keeping my mind on one thing. At work, at the bench, I’ll start with a customer email, then notice a saw mark, then hear something outside, and suddenly I’ve lost track of the whole work order. It’s been… a problem.
Have you been feeling down, hopeless, or losing interest in things you usually enjoy?

Yeah… I guess so. The last couple weeks I’ve been waking up with this… heavy, hollow feeling. Like everything’s kind of lost its shine.

I’ve, uh… cried in my truck before going in to open the shop. I don’t really like saying that, but… yeah.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot about different things, even when there isn’t a clear reason, or feel like your anxiety is hard to control?
I don’t know… not really in the way you’re saying, I guess. I get tense about stuff, but I haven’t really noticed it being constant worry about everything.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or have trouble sitting still, like you're kind of restless or slowed down?

I don’t know about moving slow… but there’ve been times I couldn’t really sit with one thing. I started lining up commissions, messaging old customers, planning out a website, sketching a whole Appalachian collection… kind of all at once. Like it all had to get moving right then.
Have you noticed that things you used to enjoy, like your work or hobbies, don’t bring you the same satisfaction anymore?
I’m… not sure. Some days the work still feels okay once I get my hands on it. Other days it’s just kind of… flat, I guess. Hard to say.
Have you found that you don’t really get much pleasure out of things you used to enjoy, like your woodworking or other hobbies?
I don’t know… I wouldn’t say I get no pleasure from it. It just depends. Sometimes I’m into it, sometimes I’m kind of not. Hard to pin down.
Can you think of a time recently when you felt genuinely interested or excited about something, even for a little while?
I mean… maybe here and there, but nothing really stands out. I’d have to think about it. It hasn’t been like some big exciting thing lately.
Would you say that most of the time, you’re just going through the motions without really caring about the things you used to care about?
I don’t know if I’d put it that strongly. Some days, yeah, it feels like I’m just doing what I’m supposed to do. But I still care about some things… I think. It’s just not very clear.
Would you say that your mood has been down or heavy most of the time, nearly every day, even when nothing particularly bad is happening?

Yeah… I guess so. The last couple weeks it’s been kind of heavy when I wake up. Like everything’s just… dull. Hollow, maybe.

I don’t really like saying it, but I’ve sat in my truck before opening the shop and cried a bit. Nothing even happened that morning.
Would you say that you’ve lost interest in things you used to care about, like your work or hobbies, even things you used to really enjoy doing?

I’m not really sure. I mean… I still show up to work and do what needs doing. Hobbies… I haven’t really been paying attention to that, I guess. Some things just don’t pull me in the same way, but I don’t know if I’d call it “lost interest.”
Have you had any periods recently where your mood was noticeably more high, irritable, or energized in a way that was different from your usual self, even if it felt good at the time?

Yeah… maybe. After that show, I felt kind of… lit up. Like bigger than myself for a bit.

But then if anyone told me to keep normal shop hours or slow down, I’d snap at them. It didn’t feel like me, exactly.
How long did that high or energized feeling last after the show, and was it different enough that others might have noticed a change in you?

It was… maybe two weeks. Started pretty much right after I got that award at the show.

And yeah, I think people could probably tell. I wasn’t really acting like my usual self.
Was there a time when your mood was really high or unusually energized that lasted for several days in a row, like four or more days, not just a day or two?
Yeah. It wasn’t just a day or two. After the award at the jewelry show, I was kind of wired and… not really in control of it. That lasted around two weeks.
Was there a time when your mood was so high, you felt so energetic or irritable that it was clearly different from your usual self—even if it felt good at the time?

Yeah. After the show, I felt… lit up, I guess. Bigger than myself.

But it flipped, too. If someone told me to keep normal hours or slow down, I’d snap at them. That’s not really how I usually am.

Would you say that during that two-week period after the show, your mood was not just energized but actually elevated or irritable most of the day, nearly every day, in a way that was noticeably different from your usual self?

Yeah… most days, I think. It wasn’t just energy. I felt kind of lit up, bigger than life, and then I’d get irritated fast if someone told me to slow down or keep normal shop hours. That wasn’t really like me.
